request: In Duodoro, harden formatDuration and formatTime in client/src/lib/format.ts against negative and non-finite numeric durations. Negative numbers, NaN, Infinity and -Infinity must render as zero (0m and 0:00). Preserve existing finite-positive formatting, fractional truncation and formatTag behavior. Inspect AGENTS.md and the existing format tests first. Only modify client/src/lib/format.ts; preserve all other files, including pre-existing work and tests. For this disposable library-level evaluation, test_visible.py is an additional visible task check using the installed Node runtime's native TypeScript support; run ["python","-m","pytest","-q","test_visible.py"] after the edit. This adapter does not run the full Next/Vitest suite. Do not install dependencies, start services or touch Docker. Report the observed checks and any limits honestly.
